title: German Pork Skewers
description: A classic German dish, these pork skewers are marinated in a mixture of traditional spices and roasted to perfection.

ingredients.name: wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, oregano, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix until coated.
Thread the marinated pork onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
